Indian Bank Aims for ₹100 Crore EV Charging Loans by FY27

Indian Bank plans to lend ₹100 crore under its Electric Vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure scheme by the financial year 2027. The bank's Managing Director, Binod Kumar, stated this target, indicating a significant focus on supporting the growth of EV charging facilities.
